assumptions.statement: Site boundary and three key areas are repository provisional rough polygons derived from announcement text extents, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All area-sensitive metrics are low-confidence design-model values and must be recalculated when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines, heritage control zones, ownership, and municipal capacities are missing from the public site package.
assumptions.impact: No statutory control, demolition, or engineering feasibility claim is made; those values stay unknown.

assumptions.statement: Tissue partition, proto-organs, generators, and pilgrimage nodes are conceptual recommendations for professional deepening.
assumptions.impact: Geometry is a research model for HISTOLOGY OF THE TRACE, not an approved urban-renewal plan.
